user_story: As a user, I want the login endpoint to return an error when the email field is empty so that I provide all required credentials.

positive.title: Successful login with valid email
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with a valid email and password.
Receive a response from the server.
positive.expected_result: Response status is 200 OK and user is logged in successfully.

negative.title: Error when email field is empty
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with an empty email field and valid password.
Receive a response from the server.
negative.expected_result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with an error message indicating that the email field is required.

edge.title: Error when email field is null
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with email set to null and a valid password.
Receive a response from the server.
edge.expected_result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with an error message indicating that the email field is required.
